biggest_catch: AppBounty looks defunct: the app has not been updated since 2019, no official company site or payout schedule can be found, and third-party reviews report gift-card rewards perpetually sold out. There is no operating company publishing payout terms to verify.
catches: No official company site found — appbounty.net (catalog URL) yields no verifiable operator or terms.
App abandoned: last APK release v2.7.3 dated 2019-08-06.
Third-party reviews report gift cards 'always sold out', making earned credits effectively unredeemable.
No cash payout option — credits convert only to gift cards, when available.
A similarly-named app ('appBOUNTY-get free cash' by 'cash rewards') was removed from Google Play on 2026-09-04 — do not confuse the two; neither is a verified operator.

c1.evidence: FAILED — no identifiable operating company. No official site, no company name, no contact; only APK-mirror listings (last update 2019) and affiliate review blogs. The app appears abandoned.

c2.evidence: FAILED — no payout terms published by any operator; third-party archives cite a $5 minimum cashout and ~500-550 points=$1, but these are unofficial and describe a defunct program.

c3.evidence: Free to join historically — moot, since the service cannot be verified to operate.

c4.evidence: No official source obtained — none exists; only APK mirrors and review blogs.

notes: Consistent with the historical note in the task brief (AppBounty one of the apps suspected dead). The 2026-09-04 Google Play removal applies to a different, similarly-named app ('appBOUNTY-get free cash' by 'cash rewards'), but the original AppBounty's own client has been untouched since 2019. Recommend removing this route from the catalog.
